meaning: The fixed check profiles a development lane grant carries (wave 13, incorporation D6). Each profile is exactly the grant check-profile shape of development_source; a check call may append only files matching targets. Limits are copied from the existing grant profile named in copied_from (wave10/incorporation/observations.txt [C7], [R7], [R8]).

os.environ['TMPDIR']=str(scratch)
import pytest
raise SystemExit(pytest.main(['-c','/dev/null','--rootdir',str(root),'-p','no:cacheprovider','-q','--basetemp',str(scratch/'pytest'),*sys.argv[1:]]))

reporter: node-tests and node-suite print through a reporter given inline as a data: module: one TAP-shaped line 'not ok N - <name>' per failing test from the runner's own test:fail events (a suite failing only because a subtest failed is not repeated), then '# pass', '# fail' and '# skipped' counts. The whole TAP stream of the 178-file suite is 1,096,019 bytes, over the 128 KiB output budget; this stream is 12,634 bytes.
lane_dependencies: node-tests and node-suite read two files outside the writable lane paths: runtime_profiles.toml (scripts/laplace-python refuses without it: 'Laplace runtime declaration unavailable') and .claude/workflows/atlas-wave.js (read by tests/atlas_wave_lifecycle.test.mjs). lane() pins each from the cut lane into the grant profile's dependencies {path: sha256}; the grant validates them and every check re-pins them before staging them read-only.
sandbox_environment: Why the node profiles look as they do (measured 2026-11-08, wave13/lane-checks/node_suite_sandbox_vs_outside.json): node runs under the registered interpreter (runtime registered-python, its bootstrap sets LAPLACE_PYTHON and execs /usr/bin/node), because 16 of the 17 files that failed only in the sandbox start scripts/laplace-python (13 of them refused 'Laplace runtime declaration unavailable' until runtime_profiles.toml was staged); --disable-wasm-trap-handler, because V8 reserves guard space for each WebAssembly memory beyond the check's 2 GiB address-space limit (memory_bytes, the owner's MAX_CHECK_MEMORY) and the reader and session tests then fail 'Cannot allocate Wasm memory'; it changes only how Wasm bounds are checked. The names that still differ from a run outside the sandbox on the same commit are listed with their cause in sandbox_differences, and every check row repeats them.
